domain: Rheumatoid arthritis — advanced therapy in moderate-to-severe RA
title: Rheumatologist Perceptions of Advanced Therapies in Moderate-to-Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary clinical role?
How many years have you been treating patients with rheumatoid arthritis?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: Which of the following advanced therapies for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis are you aware of?
What is your most important consideration when selecting an advanced therapy for moderate-to-severe RA?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: Present options in the exact order listed above. Do not randomize.

questions.text: Which advanced therapy do you prescribe most often for moderate-to-severe RA?
questions.logicNote: PROGRAMMER NOTE: The brand selected in Q3 must be piped into the text of Q4.

questions.text: How satisfied are you with [PIPE: Q3 selection] for your moderate-to-severe RA patients?

piping.note: Replace [PIPE: Q3 selection] with the brand chosen in Q3.

questions.text: Please rate your agreement with each of the following statements.
rows: Advanced therapies have transformed outcomes in rheumatoid arthritis
Prior authorization requirements delay my patients' treatment
I am comfortable prescribing JAK inhibitors given current safety guidance

questions.text: What percentage of your moderate-to-severe RA patients currently receive an advanced therapy (biologic or JAK inhibitor)?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

questions.text: In your view, what is the single biggest barrier to your patients' access to advanced therapy?
How likely are you to recommend advanced therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe RA?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
